what_it_shows: App Store categories with definitions: Productivity (task, calendar, translation, note taking, password management, cloud storage, email), Utilities (calculators, web browsing, password management, remote controls), Graphics & Design, Photo & Video, Developer Tools, Business, Finance, Education, Music, Navigation, Medical, Health & Fitness etc; Games has its own subcategories; Kids is an age-band category; password management appears in two categories

G2 category directory: about 40 parent groups (Artificial Intelligence 40 children, Collaboration & Productivity 59, Design Software 18, Security Software 16, Development, IT Management, Marketing...) mostly B2B; consumer-relevant parents Design (Graphic Design, 3D Design, Photography, Audio Editing, Font Management), Identity Management (Password Managers under it), Backup, Collaboration (Browsers, Note-Taking, Office Suites, PDF Editors, Email Client); Generative AI parent holds AI Chatbots, Image Generators, Coding Assistants; pure function axis

Capterra Browse popular software: 10 headline groups (Human Resources, Product Management & Productivity, Marketing & Sales, Operations, Service, IT & Security, Finance & Accounting, Legal & Compliance, Customer Service, Hospitality, Healthcare) each with 6-10 function categories; business-by-department axis, over 700 categories claimed

Google Play: one required category plus up to five tags per app, game categories separate; tags describe what the app does and not related genres; category determines charts and peer group (category list itself collapsed on the fetched page)

Ninite pick-apps page: 13 headings (Web Browsers, Messaging, Media, .NET, Runtimes, Imaging, Documents, Security, File Sharing, Online Storage, Other, Utilities, Compression, VC++ Redistributables, Developer Tools) with named programs (Chrome, VLC, 7-Zip, KeePass 2, 1Password, ChatGPT, Claude); AI assistants and password managers sit in Other; maker/product names are the items

AlternativeTo: 27 function categories (AI Tools & Services, Audio & Music, Backup & Sync, Security & Privacy, Photos & Graphics, Office & Productivity, Web Browsers...) plus separate License facet (Free 119.7K, Paid 46.4K, Open Source 31.2K with licence families) and Platform facet (Windows, Mac, Linux, Android, iPhone, Online, SaaS, Self-Hosted, package managers); function, licence and platform are three independent axes

Vector Windows software library: 13 top headings (Document creation, Internet and communication, Utilities 5,695, Image and sound, Business 5,585, Personal, Home and hobby, Learning and education, Games 6,623, Amusement, Programming, Hardware, plus OS/fonts in the shop) each with 10-25 sub-types (e.g. under Utilities: archive utilities, backup, file management, program launcher, security); licence (freeware, shareware) is a label on each item, not a branch

Huajun software park: top nav splits PC software, PC games, Android, iPhone, system software; PC-software function sorts include system, network, media tools, graphics, desktop, office (/sort/89), security (/sort/10), video playback, AI office (/sort/715, Doubao, Yuanbao listed); platform is a top tab, function the second level; shows an AI-office function category in a Chinese directory

Vector PC shop (paid licences) uses the same 14 Windows categories (OS, document creation, internet, utilities, image and sound, business, personal, home, education, games, amusement, programming, hardware, fonts); Windows, Macintosh, and mobile/UNIX are the platform split above function

CHIP downloads: 15 categories in which platform is a first-level split (iPhone/iPad, Android, Linux, MacOS, Windows-Apps) beside function categories (Browser/Kommunikation/Online-Tools, Office/Produktivitaet/Finanzen, Security & Datenschutz, System & Tuning, Multimedia & Kreativtools, Betriebssysteme, Handbuecher & Vorlagen); mixes platform and function axes

Wikipedia Software categories: three broad classes (application, system, programming tools); copyright-status scheme (free, open source, copylefted, proprietary, freeware, shareware); Microsoft TechNet/AIS seven-element scheme; market-based horizontal vs vertical (NAICS-based) applications

UNSPSC segment 43 Information technology, family 43230000 Software, class 43232600 Industry specific software with 19 commodities (CAD, medical, POS, facial recognition, legal, library): vertical-market software is a class

Wikipedia Software by type: 42 subcategories on one function-ish axis (Ad blocking, AI software, Application software 47 children, Productivity software, Security software, System software, Utility software by type 31, Mobile applications, Web software) beside licence-based siblings (Free software by type, Proprietary software by type, Open source) and Portable software; shows licence and platform siblings of function

UNSPSC family 4323 Software: 18 classes by function or field (business function specific, finance/ERP, game or entertainment, content authoring and editing, content management, data management, development, educational or reference, industry specific, network applications, network management, operating environment, security and protection, utility and device driver, information exchange, system management); no licence or delivery axis
